the development of a differential display technique to identify differentially expressed mRNAs in melanoma cell lines.
the isolation of genes differentially expressed in melanoma metastases.
the identification of differentially expressed mRNAs in human melanomas.

differential display is a very useful technique for the identification of differentially expressed genes in human melanoma cells with different metastatic potential.
